tasks.title: Create custom role and agent snapshot foundations
tasks.objective: Add the smallest durable role-template and agent-snapshot foundation so reusable roles are safe to select without mutating existing agents.
acceptance_criteria: Custom role templates are app-scoped, validated, and auditable.
An agent stores an immutable selected role snapshot that survives later role edit or deletion.
Protected Gantry runtime and safety prompt layers remain outside editable role content.

tasks.title: Expose truthful agent and role browser projections
tasks.objective: Provide paginated, sanitized same-origin reads and administrator mutations for agents, roles, setup, and real versions using the new role foundation and existing lifecycle services.
acceptance_criteria: Agent and custom-role lists support server-owned pagination, search, filters, sorting, and truthful totals.
Browser routes enforce session, Administrator, Origin, CSRF, and reauthentication policy without exposing Bearer access or raw records.
Source attachment, capability authority, profile versions, and agent disablement preserve their existing service-owned meanings.

tasks.title: Build Agents directory and Roles library
tasks.objective: Replace preview inventory data with a responsive, URL-stateful Agents directory and reusable Roles library backed by the browser projections.
acceptance_criteria: The directory has functional debounced search, immediate filters, sorting, pagination, loading, empty, failure, retry, and narrow-screen states.
The Roles library supports the approved built-in and custom role actions with no inert visible controls.
The old fixture data and connection-gate inventory actions are removed.

tasks.title: Build staged agent creation
tasks.objective: Create the four-step agent wizard so operators establish a base agent first and can safely save optional sources and capabilities independently.
acceptance_criteria: Step 1 validates and creates the base agent before later steps unlock.
Sources and capabilities independently save or fail without erasing earlier success.
Review accurately reflects entered and saved state, and all setup help and skip actions work.

tasks.title: Build truthful routed agent detail
tasks.objective: Replace preview agent detail with a focused routed view for configuration, instructions, access, settings, disablement, and real read-only version history.
acceptance_criteria: Overview, Instructions, Access, and Settings show only actual projected data for the selected agent.
Disable/enable confirmation and version history have real behavior and no fabricated state.
Obsolete preview tabs and no-op actions are removed.

tasks.title: Verify the complete Agents management workflow
tasks.objective: Prove the full browser workflow and remove remaining preview seams so the feature is accessible, responsive, and ready for review.
acceptance_criteria: Automated coverage proves lifecycle, facade, URL state, and visible interaction behavior.
A real local functional flow covers creation, staged setup, detail, history, disablement, re-enable, refresh, and narrow layout.
Cleanup searches find no fixture-only Agents surface, no-op shipped controls, or source-authority collapse.
